headline: Bulgaria Wins Eurovision 2026 With "Bangaranga" in Vienna
deck: Dara's performance secured Bulgaria's first-ever victory in the most unpredictable grand final in recent years.
summary: Bulgaria won the Eurovision Song Contest 2026 in Vienna on May 16, 2026, with Dara performing "Bangaranga." The grand final brought together 25 countries at Wiener Stadthalle, while five nations boycotted due to Israel's participation. Israel finished as runner-up for the second consecutive year.
